prerequisites: Second study section reached, with at least 42 ECTS credits from the first study section.

learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish between permutation, combination, and selection.
Reproduce and apply the inclusion-exclusion principle.
Understand and apply the pigeonhole principle.
Describe the basic concepts of inferential statistics.
Fundamentally handle the statistics software R.
Handle external datasets, create R-internal data objects, and apply R functions.
Implement statistical methods in R, especially for data visualization, sampling, and estimation and testing procedures.

syllabus_topics: Combinatorial counting problems: permutations, combinations, selection
Probability theory: random experiments, outcomes, sample space, events
Descriptive statistics: organization and representation of data, scale types, statistical measures, standardization of data

Inferential statistics: The normal distribution, the standard normal distribution, the sampling distribution, point and interval estimation, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, t-test, beta error and test power, confidence level, effect sizes
Variable relationships: covariance and correlation, simple linear regression, the quality of the relationship
The basic principle of analysis of variance, methods for rank and nominal data
assessment_rules: The assessment is a 90-minute written examination.
